conditions.name: Payer, user and intended use
conditions.apply_when: A licence, partner deliverable or adviser/client use is being considered.
conditions.check: What asset will be used, by whom, for which internal/client/public purpose, with what permission and briefing/servicing?
conditions.counterexample: A consultant needs a client-facing slide pack but the available package only supports internal reading.

conditions.name: Decision-fit of substitutes
conditions.apply_when: A geography or audience is being compared.
conditions.check: Which free/paid/internal alternatives actually match the country set, role, employer context and immediate decision?
conditions.counterexample: Dublin dinner interest is treated as demand for research, while the person primarily needs Irish compliance support already available elsewhere.

conditions.name: Recruitment and funder fit
conditions.apply_when: Partners nominate people or expect commercial access.
conditions.check: Does that invitation route fit the defined member/research purpose, and are recruitment origin and any optional access benefits clear?
conditions.counterexample: A sponsor wants accounts from a target list, while the research requires decision cases across a different employer/country mix.

conditions.name: Deliverability alongside funding
conditions.apply_when: A commercial bundle or cash model is being defined.
conditions.check: Which commitments, rights, approvals, research assets, attendees and servicing resources are actually ready, at which dates?
conditions.counterexample: A partner pays, but permissioned findings or approved attendees are not ready to supply the contracted benefit.
